title: Warnings of Scripture
definition: The warnings of Scripture are God's gracious and serious calls that expose danger, confront sin, guard faith, and urge repentance.
summary: Biblical warnings are not meant to produce despair in the humble but to awaken sober faith and keep God's people from destruction.
christFocus: Christ warns because He loves, calling sinners to repentance and His people to watchfulness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Warnings of Scripture teaches that God's people must receive this truth under the authority of the Lord, allowing Scripture itself to define the doctrine rather than personal opinion, tradition, or culture.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it protects the believer from confusion and helps the church remain anchored in what God has actually spoken. Without this truth, faith can drift toward feelings, assumptions, or human wisdom.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: A disciple should respond to warnings of scripture by reading the Word prayerfully, testing beliefs by Scripture, obeying what God reveals, and helping others handle the Bible with humility, clarity, and faith.

studySections.heading: Guardrails and Common Errors
studySections.content: This doctrine should not be used to win arguments while neglecting love, nor should it be separated from prayer, obedience, and dependence on the Holy Spirit. The goal is faithful submission to God, not mere possession of information.

sources: Scripture references listed in this doctrine entry.
